office_does: The county auditor runs elections and voter registration, records deeds and other public documents, issues licenses and passports, and keeps the county's accounts and payroll.
race_blurb: Republican Charles Ross, auditor since 2014 and a former state representative, seeks a fourth term against Democrat Maria Cuevas, a retired Yakima Valley College instructor. Ross runs on fair, efficient administration; Cuevas on raising the county's low turnout, Spanish-language service and an independent review of the office.

candidates.summary: Three-term Yakima County Auditor, former 14th District state representative and former Naches mayor.
highlights: Auditor since 2014; state representative 2006-2014; Naches councilman and mayor 1997-2006 [S1]
Says he implements laws he does not always agree with in a fair, professional manner [S1]
Says county plans focus on quality services 'while living within our means' [S3]

experience.basis: Three-term incumbent auditor with eight years in the Legislature and nine as a town official.

spending.basis: Describes county planning focused on 'living within our means and being accountable to taxpayers'.

candidates.summary: Retired Yakima Valley College sociology instructor making her first run for office, focused on turnout, bilingual service and public reporting.
highlights: Says the county's turnout is the lowest in the state and would expand outreach to reduce ballot rejections [S1][S2]
Would publish signature challenges and cures by precinct [S2]
Would commission an independent operational review of the office and publish a spending dashboard [S2]
Calls vote-by-mail 'the most democratic way to ensure that everyone participates' [S3]

experience.basis: No prior elected office; runs to 'change the standard' of an office she says has not served the full community.

spending.basis: Proposes a year-one independent operational review, public payroll and expenditure dashboards and internal controls against waste.
